title: Redesigned traces around the answer workflow
points: Failure case: traces still felt like implementation panels instead of a readable audit trail, with too many internal stage names and duplicated summary chips.
Flow logic changed: the trace viewer now starts with a compact run summary and presents the workflow as Plan, Retrieve, Compute, Write, and Verify.
Shipped result: users can follow how an answer was produced in order, opening raw JSON, SQL, prompts, artifacts, and source logs only inside the relevant stage.
